decoded_text: The capital of France is the capital of the country.
notes: The weights are bfloat16, so the conversion to f32 is exact: f32::from_bits((bits as u32) << 16).
The reference runs in float32 so that a divergence is attributable to the maths of the runtime and not to the rounding of the weights.
vocab.json maps a token string to its id, not the other way round: the decoder has to build the inverse map.
The token strings are in the byte level alphabet of GPT-2, where each character stands for one byte, so the decoder inverts that mapping and assembles bytes before decoding them as UTF-8.
The prompt is pre-encoded: the runtime does not implement a pre-tokenizer, so these ids are baked into it.
